messages:
maya: Hey — just finished unboxing my M2 Pro and ran the Kandji enrollment, but I'm stuck in a login loop and Keychain keeps asking for my old macOS password. FileVault keeps prompting on boot. Anyone know who to ping for a temp-admin or a clean re-enroll? @it-support
onboard-bot: Welcome to Redwood, @maya! :tada: I added the "new-hire checklist" link to your DM. IT usually helps with temp-admins for onboarding — pinging them now.
it-support: Hi Maya — welcome! Can you paste the output of these two commands (copy/paste is fine):
```
/usr/bin/fdesetup status
/usr/bin/profiles status -type enrollment
sw_vers -productVersion
```
Also, did you restore from a Time Machine or Migration Assistant backup?
maya: Sure — ran them just now, output below:
```
$ fdesetup status
FileVault is On.
$ profiles status -type enrollment
Enrolled via Kandji (MDM) — profile active
$ sw_vers -productVersion
13.5.2
```
I did restore from a personal Time Machine (iCloud backup) earlier in the week.
alex: restore from backup explains the old keychain/password prompts. Migration Assistant often pulls an old login keychain which won't match the new local account password. Two safe options: (1) back up any user files and do a fresh user account + keychain reset, or (2) targeted re-enroll + keychain migration. If you need to keep app data, we usually do option 2 with temp-admin.
carlos: I can grant temporary admin for 30 minutes and push a re-enroll if you want to try option 2. @maya — I'll DM you to confirm your laptop serial. Meanwhile, don't enter any passwords you don't recognize.
people-ops: Quick welcome from People Ops too :wave: — let us know if you need VPN or SSO access validated after the re-enroll.
maya: Thanks @carlos, DM received. One quick Q: is there a safe local command I can run to force authentication restart without touching keychains?
it-support: Yes, you can try an authrestart which attempts a secure reboot for FileVault auth: `sudo fdesetup authrestart` — but that won't fix a mismatched keychain. After we push re-enroll you may still need to create a new login keychain via Keychain Access: Keychain Access > Preferences > Reset My Default Keychain. We'll walk you through it over DM.
carlos: Update: temp-admin granted (30m) and Kandji targeted re-enroll pushed. @maya — reboot when ready and follow the prompt to allow system profile install. I'll monitor the session.
maya: Rebooted and saw the Kandji prompt, allowed it. FileVault stopped prompting and I was able to log in — Keychain Access showed an "old_login" keychain but I reset defaults and salvaged passwords I needed. All good on my end. Thank you!! :relieved:
carlos: Great — closing the loop. If anything else crops up (VPN, certs, SSO), tag #help or DM it-support. Welcome aboard again, @maya :tada:
